question: Should the repository accept item-number-scoped pending capacity for deferred exact-verdict router dispatches while preserving the existing repository-scoped broad-scan group?
rationale: The patch changes live GitHub Actions concurrency behavior, and the PR author is a repository member; repository policy requires explicit maintainer judgment rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept scoped dispatch concurrency
options.body: Approve the item-number group because it prevents unrelated deferred exact verdicts from replacing each other while broad scans remain repository-scoped.

options.title: Request a narrower operational contract
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want a different keying or explicit serialization policy for multi-item workflow dispatches before landing it.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped dispatch concurrency
recommendation.body: Approve the item-number group because it prevents unrelated deferred exact verdicts from replacing each other while broad scans remain repository-scoped.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available repository-member contributor for this focused workflow change and can clarify the intended dispatch contract.
